card.name: Duration words before waiting or titration periods
card.fires_on: The time unit or article inside a duration phrase like 'a 4-week', 'six month' or 'a short' that comes right before a noun such as period, titration, cessation or exposure.

modes.description: A unit such as -week or -day after a number, followed by a period or titration noun.
